about: The checkout-recovery contract between Scrooge (producer: GET /dash/orders, POST /dash/orders/email) and Pionir (consumer: crew contracts.orders, adapter client.email). The SAME file lives in Scrooge at worker/test/fixtures/checkout-recovery-contract.json and in Pionir at tests/fixtures/scrooge_checkout_recovery_contract.json. Both test suites pin the sha256 of its canonical JSON (keys sorted, no spaces): change one copy and both pins, or the other side fails.

listed_order.name: Ana Lima
listed_order.brief: A script that renames the invoice PDFs in a folder by their date.

recovery_email_request.subject: Your Dokaz order a1b2c3d4e5f6 is still waiting for payment
recovery_email_request.body_text:
Hello Ana Lima,

You started an order with us, but the checkout closed before the payment went through, so nothing was charged.

Order: a1b2c3d4e5f6
Package: Small ($149)

If you'd still like us to do it, you can finish the payment here:
{recovery_link}

The link opens the same checkout and works until 2026-11-02 (UTC). If you've changed your mind, there's nothing to do: this is the only reminder we'll send about it.

Thank you,
Dokaz
